## Biography
Rohit Chouhan (frequently searched as Rohit Chauhan) is a Software Engineer based in Sangli, Maharashtra, India. He specializes in React Native mobile development for Android and iOS, complemented by full-stack engineering expertise in Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, and modern database architectures (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase).

Rohit currently serves as a Software Engineer at GTT Data Solutions in Sangli, where he builds, optimizes, and ships enterprise-grade mobile applications. Notably, he played a critical role in conducting compliance audits and migrating 6+ production mobile applications to comply with Google's Android 16KB memory page-size standard. In addition to enterprise projects, Rohit has delivered freelance client products, deploying backends and databases independently on Microsoft Azure Windows VMs with DuckDNS dynamic routing and Caddy reverse proxies.

## Work History
### GTT Data Solutions, Sangli | Software Engineer (May 2025 – Present)
- Develops and maintains production React Native applications for commercial clients in Scrum/Agile workflows.
- Implements offline-first architectures utilizing SQLite and Redux Toolkit with automated queue-based network synchronization.
- Integrates Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for background and foreground notifications and Google Maps SDK for real-time tracking.
- Optimizes mobile applications with lazy loading, list memoization, and pagination, reducing initial app load time by up to 40%.
- Led dependency audits and migration across 6+ production apps for Google's Android 16KB page-size policy.
- Directly handles production deployments to the Google Play Console for client apps including RSF and MahaGPS.
